why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: Open wick.xyz/waitlist and check the address in your browser. Warning Other sites use the Wick name, including one selling a "$WICK" token that has nothing to do with this project. Wick hasn't published a token contract, so any WICK token on sale today is unofficial.

Connect the wallet you signed up with. The page says: "Connect your wallet to view your registration." Warning Viewing your registration shouldn't need a token approval or a transaction. Read every request in your wallet and refuse anything like that.
Follow @wick_xyz on X for the reveal Wick has promised before the Lighter EVM launch, and for what "recognized" turns out to mean.
